value.rationale: Minimal parallel-pair degeneration of a uniform rank-two matroid induces a provably non-pure-dimensional singular locus, with exact line and isolated counts, distinct transverse ranks and multiplicities. This is a natural structural question about the simplest nonuniform matroid toric family; not merely recomputation of a known polytope face table.
